observations: Six oval heads with open mouths and dark eye sockets rise across the upper half; the figures grow taller toward the right, their bodies dissolving into long vertical white and yellow streaks.
A dense band of small black and white pointed shapes runs across the bottom edge, sitting below the figures.
The background layers soft pink and peach washes with large pale circles upper-left, while blue, magenta, and yellow lines loop loosely over and through the figures.
reading: A row of open-mouthed forms crowds the picture plane, each head built from looping lines in blue, magenta, and yellow over pale washes. The mouths read as screaming or singing — the image does not resolve which. Bodies trail downward in long white streaks, losing solidity before they reach the jagged lower band. The soft background circles sit quietly against that density, pulling the mood in two directions at once.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbor nnxyz nnotb #13 shares open-mouthed forms and layered line color but works against a black ground with denser, compact bodies. This work opens the space with pale washes and vertical dissolution — a direct formal contrast visible across the two owned neighbors.

connections.reason: Both works show multiple open-mouthed heads built from overlapping colored lines, but #13 packs its forms tightly against black while #14 spreads them vertically across pale washes, making the contrast in spatial feeling direct and visible.

lookingQuestion: Where exactly does each figure's body end and the background begin, and what does that boundary — or its absence — do to how you read the group?
